members.name: tvg_saver_save_paint
members.signature: Tvg_Result tvg_saver_save_paint(Tvg_Saver saver, Tvg_Paint paint, const char* path, uint32_t quality)
members.brief: Exports the given `paint` data to the given `path`
description: If the saver module supports any compression mechanism, it will optimize the data size. This might affect the encoding/decoding time in some cases. You can turn off the compression if you wish to optimize for speed.

params.name: saver
params.description: The Tvg_Saver object connected with the saving task.

params.name: paint
params.description: The paint to be saved with all its associated properties.

params.name: path
params.description: A path to the file, in which the paint data is to be saved.

params.name: quality
params.description: The encoded quality level. @c 0 is the minimum, @c 100 is the maximum value(recommended).

retvals.description: Trying to save a file with an unknown extension or in an unsupported format.
An empty paint is to be saved.

notes: Saving can be asynchronous if the assigned thread number is greater than zero. To guarantee the saving is done, call tvg_saver_sync() afterwards.

members.name: tvg_saver_save_animation
members.signature: Tvg_Result tvg_saver_save_animation(Tvg_Saver saver, Tvg_Animation animation, const char* path, uint32_t quality, uint32_t fps)
members.brief: Exports the given `animation` data to the given `path`
description: If the saver module supports any compression mechanism, it will optimize the data size. This might affect the encoding/decoding time in some cases. You can turn off the compression if you wish to optimize for speed.

params.name: saver
params.description: The Tvg_Saver object connected with the saving task.

params.name: animation
params.description: The animation to be saved with all its associated properties.

params.name: path
params.description: A path to the file, in which the animation data is to be saved.

params.name: quality
params.description: The encoded quality level. @c 0 is the minimum, @c 100 is the maximum value(recommended).

params.name: fps
params.description: The frames per second for the animation. If @c 0, the default fps is used.

retvals.description: Currently saving other resources or animation has no frames.
Trying to save a file with an unknown extension or in an unsupported format.
Unknown if attempting to save an empty paint.

notes: A higher frames per second (FPS) would result in a larger file size. It is recommended to use the default value.
Saving can be asynchronous if the assigned thread number is greater than zero. To guarantee the saving is done, call tvg_saver_sync() afterwards.

members.name: tvg_saver_sync
members.brief: Guarantees that the saving task is finished.
description: The behavior of the Saver module works on a sync/async basis, depending on the threading setting of the Initializer. Thus, if you wish to have a benefit of it, you must call tvg_saver_sync() after the tvg_saver_save_paint() in the proper delayed time. Otherwise, you can call tvg_saver_sync() immediately.

params.name: saver
params.description: The Tvg_Saver object connected with the saving task.

notes: The asynchronous tasking is dependent on the Saver module implementation.

params.name: saver
params.description: The Tvg_Saver object to be deleted.
